findings.text: missing_rubric_self_checks has no production caller: a grep at 4d2902649 finds only its own definition and the three assertions in tests/test_review_repair_runs_without_the_coordinator.py, so the reader its docstring calls 'the reader a delivery's reviewer consults' is consulted by nobody and no promotion or review path can report a manifest that omits a self-check.

RUBRIC_SELF_CHECK_CONTRACT asks for `rubric.<dimension>: <state>` without naming the six dimension words the reader keys on (REVIEW_DIMENSIONS, reckon/crew/review.py:87); the constant sits in the invariant prefix so it reaches every project, and a worker that records six lines under its own dimension names is reported as having recorded none, a mismatch no test can catch while the reader has no caller.
